text: bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesu nibbindati saddesu gandhesu rasesu phoṭṭhabbesu dhammesu nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati . vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti . khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . dasamaṃ . devadahavaggo catuttho . tassuddānaṃ devadahakhaṇopaggayha 1 aggayha deva honti manasinā 2 hetunāpi tayo vuttā duve ajjhattabāhirāti . __________ #1 ma. devadaho khaṇo rūpā deva na tumhākameva ca . yu. devadahakhaṇo saṅgayha . #2 yu. palāsinā . navapurāṇavaggo pañcamo [227] navapurāṇāni bhikkhave kammāni desissāmi kammanirodhañca kammanirodhagāminiñca
